title: N-Body Orbital Sandbox
description: A browser-based gravity simulator for exploring how multiple bodies interact under Newtonian gravitation. Use it to test initial conditions, inspect orbital paths and prototype mechanics for later space-science visualisations.

title: Carbon Reduction Plan
description: A clear, accessible presentation of a carbon reduction plan: organisational commitments, emissions-reduction measures, delivery milestones and progress information in a format intended to be straightforward to maintain and publish.

title: Wildfire Story Lab
description: An interactive storytelling prototype for explaining wildfire risk, landscape conditions and climate context. It explores how maps, visual sequences and evidence-led annotations can make complex environmental narratives easier to follow.

title: Contrast Lab
description: A WCAG colour-contrast checker for testing foreground and background combinations against AA and AAA contrast requirements. It is intended as a quick accessibility check during interface design and component development.

title: Component Sandbox
description: A working catalogue for reviewing reusable Astro interface components before they are adopted elsewhere. It provides rendered examples, implementation snippets and a place to test states, responsiveness and accessibility behaviour.

title: Climate Visualiser
description: A science-communication visualisation that presents temperature anomalies as an interpretable time series, combining charts with concise annotations that explain long-term warming, variability and the limits of the underlying data.

title: Mechanics
description: An interactive classical-mechanics lab covering forces on an inclined plane, friction, momentum transfer in Newton's cradle, projectile motion and vehicle stopping distance. Each simulation is designed to connect numerical relationships with visible motion.

title: Graphs
description: A flexible graphing and data-visualisation workspace for experimenting with datasets, analytical metrics and custom chart configurations. It acts as a starting point for interactive explanatory charts rather than a general-purpose spreadsheet.

title: Satellites
description: An interactive satellite tracker that propagates General Perturbations orbital data with SGP4, adds satellite-catalogue context and displays positions and ground tracks on an interactive map. It is designed for exploration and situational awareness, not precision operational tracking.

title: Drought
description: A UK-focused drought-risk monitor that brings together drought-observatory indicators with hydrology data from the Environment Agency and SEPA. It is intended to show how rainfall, soil moisture, river flows, groundwater and vegetation stress can point to different forms of drought.

title: Tintwistle
description: A place-based environmental monitoring prototype for Tintwistle and its surrounding landscape. The project provides a home for exploring local geography, weather, environmental conditions and public datasets through a focused local lens.

title: Biodiversity
description: A habitat-health monitor combining vegetation greenness from satellite observation, designated-site boundaries and water-quality records. It explores how multiple environmental signals can be viewed together without treating any single indicator as a complete measure of ecological condition.

title: Sewage
description: A monitoring prototype for storm-overflow activations, placing water-company event data alongside rainfall and soil-moisture context. It is designed to help users explore timing and patterns, not to determine causes or regulatory compliance from a single data source.

title: Atmosphere
description: An air-quality profile for Leicestershire that brings together modelled atmospheric conditions and AURN monitoring observations. It aims to show nitrogen dioxide, ozone and particulate context across altitude and time, while clearly distinguishing model output from ground measurements.

title: Flow Around Objects
description: A browser-based two-dimensional fluid-flow simulation using a D2Q9 lattice Boltzmann model. Compare air or water flowing around an aerofoil, square or cylinder, inspect pressure and vorticity fields, and observe drag, lift and vortex shedding. It is an educational model, not an experimentally validated CFD tool.

title: Electricity
description: An interactive introduction to basic circuit behaviour, showing how voltage, current and resistance relate as component values change. It is designed to make Ohm's law and simple circuit relationships more visual and testable.

title: Elements
description: An interactive periodic table for exploring the chemical elements, their classifications and the patterns that emerge across groups and periods. It is designed as a compact visual reference and learning tool.

title: Rubik's Cube
description: An interactive Rubik's Cube experiment for exploring three-dimensional transformations, move notation and algorithmic problem-solving. It provides a practical bridge between a familiar puzzle and ideas from geometry, permutations and state-space search.

title: Astronomy
description: A broader astronomy lab for interactive visualisers covering observing, the Solar System, stellar and galactic phenomena, and the physical scales used to understand the Universe. Individual tools can develop independently while sharing a clear astronomy home.

title: Space
description: A broader space lab for interactive visualisers covering rockets, satellites.....

title: Physics
description: A physics lab for interactive simulations and explainers across mechanics, waves, electricity, fluids, relativity and modern physics. It provides a common home for experiments that prioritise intuition, visual feedback and transparent assumptions.

title: Maths
description: A maths lab for interactive exploration of functions, graphs, equations, geometry, probability and numerical methods. Its purpose is to make abstract relationships easier to inspect by changing inputs and immediately seeing the result.

title: Climate
description: A climate lab for interactive tools that connect observations, long-term trends, risk indicators and adaptation choices. It is a shared home for clear, evidence-led climate communication rather than a single model or dataset.

title: Weather
description: A weather lab for presenting local conditions, forecasts, historical observations and weather-related hazards in a readable, interactive form. It is intended to distinguish short-term weather from long-term climate context while showing how they connect.
